seo.description: Southern Machinery smart feeder solutions for SMT & THT: axial tape feeders with U-shaping and lead trimming, radial tape feeders for DIP and odd-form parts, bowl feeders for bulk components, MES-ready label feeders and automated tray feeders. Compatible with any SMT machine. www.smthelp.com
seo.og_image_alt: Smart Feeder Solutions poster — axial, radial, bowl, label and tray feeders for SMT & THT lines with high compatibility and custom non-standard designs.

key_specs.Axial Tape Feeder: U-shaping & lead trimming; high-speed, stable feeding with reliable linkage
key_specs.Radial Tape Feeder: Feeding, shaping, cutting & bending of radial parts; supports DIP insertion and odd-form components
key_specs.Bowl Feeder: Bulk component feeding; sorts, orients and automates part feeding
key_specs.Label Feeder: Automatic QR label placement for MES; handles labels, FPC sheets and diverse reel materials
key_specs.Tray Feeder: Automated tray material supply; ideal for 3C products and auxiliary lines
key_specs.Engineering: Custom non-standard solutions tailored for odd-form and special components
key_specs.Benefit: Improved labor utilization — automated feeding and handling reduce manual labor
